author: toketrain
body:
Info:
hey guys! so earlier i was thinking about the walls, and it seems like most of the maps are very detailed, there's a lot to them, they're really aesthetically pleasing and such and they're all great maps, but i think in the rotation somewhere there should be a simple map. there wouldn't be much to it, but it'd work as a walls map well.

so i created one. it doesn't have a name yet, but hopefully you guys can help me with that.
each quadrant is an island, and to fit with the simple theme i incorporated themes from older, simpler maps. the team names, the classic team color set-up (red/blue/green/yellow). and i also put in some easter eggs for those who knew those maps well; a mine set to the theme of the original walls map, a little cave that looks like the jungle map cave, and some other stuff.
fyi the yml won't work until i get a name, because right now it's a "?" which won't work. i didn't realize this when writing the yml.

Name:
(needed)

Creators:
tribblei

Gamemode:
the walls

Download:
 https://www.mediafire.com/?83wygohg3ynpygd

http://pastebin.com/i7cDr66c

comment feedback + name suggestions!

replies.author: FlufflesSub
replies.body:
[Denied] Unfortunately your map had been denied and will not be featured on The Avicus Network neither the Repository.

Your map had been denied due too the following reasons:
- Quadrents have a lack of land, due to the amount of water in each sector, affecting gameplay and smoothness of the game.
- The map is generally to small and lacks intricacy, it is currently to plain, especially within the middle zone, I suggest you take into account previous suggestions.
- The map is empty making the gameplay uninteresting, furthermore, it has nothing special to make the map stand out in comparison to current rotations.

Best of luck if you decide in continuing to improve upon this map :)
